captions.detailed: A classic cocktail-table arcade machine styled with a dark, low-profile cabinet base and a glass top. A horizontal screen is recessed inside a central well on the top surface. One side of the upper cabinet features a small protruding control panel shelf holding three colored arcade buttons (red, yellow, and blue). A service door with a small silver handle is located on one of the narrow vertical sides of the base cabinet. The service door is hinged to swing open, and the three colored buttons can be pressed down independently as prismatic controls.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cocktail-table arcade machine with a dark cabinet base, a recessed screen well under a glass top, and a side-mounted control panel shelf holding red, yellow, and blue buttons. Ensure the service door on the side of the cabinet is a separate part with a revolute joint, and make each button an independent prismatic joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining a base pedestal and a main cabinet body using Box primitives. A glass top and a recessed screen well are modeled using thin Box volumes on top. A control panel shelf is created as a separate part on one side. The service door is modeled as a Box with a small silver handle, attached to the cabinet base via a revolute joint. Three individual push buttons are modeled as colored Cylinder primitives and attached to the control panel shelf using prismatic joints with vertical translation limits.
